t: Founded in 1724 by the Mughal viceroy Nizam-ul-Mulk, Asaf Jah I, who made the Deccan his hereditary domain.
A British ally under a subsidiary alliance from 1798, it became the largest and richest princely state in India.
Its last Nizam sought independence in 1947; India annexed the state in Operation Polo in September 1948.
dyk: Osmania University, founded in 1918, taught in Urdu, and a state translation bureau rendered textbooks in medicine, engineering and law into the language.
ev: Nizam-ul-Mulk defeats Mubariz Khan at Shakar Kheda
Baji Rao I defeats Nizam-ul-Mulk at Palkhed
Nizam Ali Khan moves the capital to Hyderabad
Subsidiary alliance with the East India Company
Berar’s revenues assigned to the British; Salar Jung I becomes chief minister
Mir Osman Ali Khan founds Osmania University
The Indian army takes over the state in Operation Polo
Hyderabad State is divided on linguistic lines
